rulings.receiver_proof: get/insert/remove are admitted only on a statically proven Object-origin receiver (anonymous object literal, group, unlabeled block tail, or a local whose initializer and every assignment are Object-origin); contains_key and is_empty also run on dynamic receivers under the C17a absence certificate
rulings.key_move: insert copies its String key and leaves the key handle readable, in both engines since S2
rulings.order: insertion order in both engines (O1); remove shift-removes
rulings.wrong_key_type: stock message copied exactly (Expected type String, Bad argument #1)
rulings.iteration_conflict: insert/remove while the Object is iterated: Cannot write the receiver: it is being read (copied)
rulings.self_insert: copied: the reference cycle stays charged until the store closes (retained_cycle pins the charged entry)
rulings.warnings: stock LetPatternMightPanic for `for (k, v) in o`; the fresh frontend does not report it (O1 precedent)
rulings.wrong_receiver: fresh names the missing method (existing D1 intentional diagnostic)
